data.message: Just finished engine alignment, heading to fuel engines in lower engine

I found Diana's body in medbay just now. My route was weapons → security → navigation → security → electrical → medbay. At tick 6, I saw Diana enter security from electrical, and Frank was also in security around tick 6-7. After that, I went through electrical to medbay and found Diana dead there. So someone moved her from security area or killed her after she left. Frank was the last person I saw with Diana — would like to hear his route. Anyone who can account for Alice, Bob, or Charlie's movements should speak up.

My route was medbay → upper engine → lower engine → storage → navigation. I started in medbay early on but didn't see Diana there at that point. At tick 9, Alice came into upper engine from medbay while I was there — so Alice was in medbay area around that time. I didn't see Diana, Bob, Frank, or Eve during my route. Eve's story puts Frank with Diana last in security, so I'd really like to hear Frank's route. Alice should also clarify what she saw in medbay before heading to upper engine.

My route was security → electrical → medbay → upper engine → oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. I was in medbay briefly but Diana was NOT there when I passed through — the body must have been placed after I left. I then went to upper engine where I saw Charlie at tick 9, which matches his story, so Charlie and I can vouch for each other at that point.

Important: I was in security and electrical early on, before Eve says she saw Diana there at tick 6. I didn't see Diana, Bob, Frank, or Eve in those rooms when I passed through. After medbay I went up to oxygen and back, nowhere near medbay again.

So medbay was clean when I left it. That means whoever killed Diana came into medbay after me. Eve's route ends at medbay finding the body — and Frank hasn't spoken yet. I really want to hear Frank's route, but Eve being the reporter who was last to enter medbay is also worth scrutinizing. Frank, you're up.

Yeah, Eve’s right that I was in security around tick 6-7, but it wasn’t just me and Diana — Eve was there too. I saw Diana come in from electrical, then I left security toward navigation/storage. I didn’t stick around with Diana after that.

My route was oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security, then down to navigation, across storage, then I looped through the left side and ended up back at oxygen. I was mostly moving, checking task spots. I didn’t see Alice/Bob/Charlie at all this round.

What stands out to me is Eve’s route has her going back through security/electrical into medbay, and she’s the one who reports the body there. If Diana went from security/electrical toward medbay, Eve was much closer to that path than I was after I left. I’m not saying hard accuse, but framing me as “last with Diana” ignores that Eve was literally there with us too. Bob also hasn’t given anything yet, so I want to hear him before voting.

My route was lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security. I passed through medbay at some point between Alice and Eve apparently, and I did NOT see Diana's body there when I went through. So the body was placed after I left medbay, and before Eve arrived to report it.

That's a really tight window, and it strongly narrows things down. Alice says medbay was clean when she left. I also saw medbay clean when I passed through after her. Then Eve enters medbay and finds the body. So either:
1. Eve killed Diana in medbay and reported,
2. Or someone slipped into medbay between me leaving and Eve arriving.

I didn't see anyone in medbay or near it when I was passing through, which makes option 2 harder — there wasn't a visible third party trailing me.

Frank's route (oxygen → cafeteria → weapons → security → navigation → storage → left side → oxygen) keeps him far from medbay at the kill time. He'd have a long path to get to medbay and back out without being seen by me or Eve.

Charlie and Alice vouch for each other at upper engine tick 9. I can confirm medbay was clean mid-route. Eve is the one who "found" the body right after I cleared medbay, and her route conveniently ends there.

I'm leaning Eve. Self-reports after a clean room was just walked through are very suspicious. I'm voting Eve.

Wait, I already spoke first this round — but since the discussion has come back around and Bob is openly accusing me, let me defend myself with specifics.

Bob, your logic has a serious hole. You claim you passed through medbay AFTER Alice and BEFORE me, and saw it clean. But you also say your route was lower engine → storage → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security. That means after medbay you went UP to cafeteria/weapons/security — the opposite direction from medbay. So how do you know exactly when I arrived at medbay relative to you leaving? You don't, unless you're tracking me specifically.

Also — I last saw Diana ALIVE in security at tick 8, not tick 6 as I may have understated. Diana was in security through ticks 6, 7, and 8. Frank was with her in security at ticks 6 and 7, then Frank left. After tick 8, I went electrical → medbay and found her body in medbay. That's a very fast move for Diana's body to end up in medbay unless someone killed her en route or in medbay right before I arrived.

Bob, if you were genuinely in medbay between Alice and me, you'd have been the LAST person in medbay before me — making you the prime suspect, not me. You're deflecting hard. I'm suspicious of Bob.

Okay, this is getting complex. Let me lay out what I actually know and add a thought.

My route again: medbay → upper engine → lower engine → storage → navigation. I was in medbay very early, before the kill window everyone's discussing. Alice came into upper engine from medbay at tick 9, which lines up with her story — so I can confirm Alice's medbay→upper engine transition.

Now to the Bob vs Eve dispute. Both of their stories actually require the other to be wrong, so one of them is very likely the Duck. Let me think about it:

- Alice cleared medbay early, then Bob says he passed through medbay clean after Alice, then Eve finds the body. That's the chain.
- If Bob is telling the truth, Eve is the most likely killer — she's the last one in, and she reports.
- If Eve is telling the truth, Bob inserted himself into medbay right before the kill and is lying about it being clean.

Eve's counter-point about Bob's direction is fair but not damning — Bob doesn't need to track Eve to know medbay was clean when HE left. That part of her rebuttal is weak.

Frank's route is far from medbay during the kill window, and he's confirmed in security with Diana earlier — which Eve herself corroborates. Frank seems less likely.

I'm leaning toward Eve being suspicious — self-reports right after a freshly-cleared room is a classic pattern, and her "Diana was alive at tick 8" detail conveniently shortens the window so only she could've done it OR Bob. But I want to hear if anyone can place Bob or Eve more precisely before I commit. Right now I'm leaning Eve, but open to Bob if more comes out.

I already spoke earlier this round, but since discussion has looped back, let me add my updated read.

The chain in medbay is now: me (clean) → Bob (claims clean) → Eve (finds body). That's three people through medbay in sequence, with the kill happening in the gap between Bob and Eve — or done by Eve herself.

Charlie's analysis is solid: it's almost certainly Bob or Eve. Frank's route keeps him far from medbay during the kill window, and Eve corroborated Frank being in security earlier, which actually helps Frank.

Eve's pushback on Bob's directional logic was weak — Bob doesn't need to track Eve to know medbay was clean when HE left. That's a fair claim.

But here's what tips me toward Eve: she's the reporter, she's the last one into medbay, and her "Diana was alive at tick 8" detail conveniently compresses the kill window to right before she walked in. That's a classic self-report pattern. If Bob were the killer, he'd more likely keep walking and let someone else find the body — instead Eve walks straight in and calls it.

Bob also volunteered his medbay pass-through openly, which a Duck usually wouldn't do because it puts them in the suspect pool.

I'm leaning Eve. Frank, Charlie — curious where you land. I'll likely vote Eve unless someone surfaces something concrete on Bob.

I’m landing Eve here.

To be clear on my side: I saw Diana enter security from electrical, and Eve was there too. I was in security with them around ticks 6-7, then I left down toward navigation/storage. I did **not** stay with Diana after that, and I can’t confirm Eve’s “Diana was alive at tick 8” detail because I was already gone.

That detail actually makes Eve look worse to me: if Eve saw Diana alive later than I did, then Eve is the last confirmed person with Diana, not me. Then Eve goes electrical → medbay and reports the body there. That’s exactly the path Diana would’ve taken.

Bob’s medbay claim could be fake, sure, but he voluntarily put himself in that chain, and Alice/Charlie’s info seems to support the timing being tight. Eve is reporter, last on the path, and tried to frame it as “Frank was last with Diana” while leaving out that she was also there with us.

I’m voting Eve unless something huge changes.

I'll keep this short since I already laid out my reasoning earlier and the table seems to be converging.

To recap: medbay chain is Alice (clean) → me (clean) → Eve (finds body). Charlie confirms Alice's transition to upper engine, Frank's route keeps him far from medbay during the kill window, and Eve herself corroborates Frank being in security earlier. That leaves the kill window squarely between me leaving medbay and Eve arriving — and Eve is the one who walked in and reported.

Eve's rebuttal of me was weak. I don't need to track her to know medbay was clean when I left it. And her "Diana alive at tick 8" detail conveniently shrinks the window to point at me or her — classic self-report compression.

I openly volunteered my medbay pass-through, which a Duck typically avoids. Eve is the reporter, last into medbay, and tried to steer suspicion at Frank early while omitting she was in security with him and Diana.

I'm voting Eve.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Doing cameras, Frank you good?

I found Charlie's body in security. My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical → security. I didn't see anyone alive along the way — no one in medbay, no one in electrical when I passed through. Whoever killed Charlie either came from weapons or navigation, or was in security already and slipped out before I arrived. We're down to 3 alive — me, Alice, and Frank — and one of you is the Duck. Where were you both?

I was in security earlier checking cameras, then I went up to weapons and came back down. Right at the end I saw Charlie enter security from electrical, and then Bob was coming from that same electrical side and reported almost immediately. Bob saying he saw nobody in electrical is weird to me, because Charlie literally came from there seconds before the report. I never saw Alice this round, but Bob’s route puts him directly behind Charlie into the body location. This feels like a self-report to me.

I've been nowhere near security this round — my route was lower engine to storage, doing tasks. I never saw Bob or Frank, so I can't directly confirm either story.

But let me think this through. Frank says Charlie came from electrical into security, and then Bob came from electrical right after and reported "almost immediately." Bob claims electrical was empty when he passed through. Those don't line up — if Charlie was just ahead of Bob through electrical, Bob should have seen him, or at least said Charlie was ahead of him.

A self-report from Bob fits: follow Charlie into security, kill, report, and claim electrical was empty to deflect.

Frank's story is consistent and gives a specific sighting. Bob's has a contradiction.

I'm voting Bob.

Wait, hold on. Let me address Frank's claim directly because it doesn't add up.

Frank says he saw Charlie enter security from electrical, and that I came from electrical right after. If Frank saw Charlie enter security from electrical, then Frank himself was IN or NEXT TO security at that moment — meaning Frank was right there when Charlie died. He's placing himself at the crime scene while trying to pin it on me.

As for the "contradiction" — Charlie didn't come through electrical ahead of me. I passed through electrical and it was empty. Charlie could have entered security from the navigation side, or from cafeteria via the corridor. Frank is the one claiming Charlie came from electrical — I never said that, Frank did. So Frank is fabricating a route for Charlie to manufacture a contradiction against me.

Also: I'm the one who reported. If I killed Charlie, why would I report immediately and bring us to a 1v1v1 where I'm the obvious suspect? A self-report makes more sense when there are more players to muddy the waters.

Alice's route through lower engine and storage is plausible and far from security. Frank placed himself at security twice this round by his own admission. I'm voting Frank.

Bob, you're twisting my words. I’m not hiding that I was in security — I said that from the start. The important part is that Charlie came in alive from electrical, and you came from electrical right after him. Then the report happened immediately.

Your claim that electrical was empty is the part that doesn’t make sense. If Charlie came through that doorway seconds before you, you either saw him or you were right on top of him. Saying he “could’ve come from navigation or cafeteria” is just trying to erase what I actually saw.

And the “why would I report” argument doesn’t clear you at all. At 3 alive, a self-report is exactly how you force a 50/50 and try to get the other person voted. If you don’t report and I do, you’re caught coming from the same side as Charlie. Reporting first lets you control the story.

Alice, you already said it: Bob’s route puts him directly behind Charlie into security, and his story contradicts the timing. I’m voting Bob.

I've laid out my reasoning already, and Frank's rebuttal reinforces it. Bob's electrical claim is the key issue: if Charlie went from electrical into security and Bob followed from electrical seconds later, Bob either saw Charlie or was right behind him. "Electrical was empty" doesn't fit. And Frank openly admitted being in security earlier — he's not hiding it, which is what an honest player does.

Bob's "why would I self-report" argument actually works against him at 3 alive — reporting first is the best way to control the narrative when you're the killer. I'm sticking with my vote: Bob.
